creature_note: None in the box. Visitors (guests) and helper staff are the living content; see classes.
classes: Handyman: sweeps, waters, mows, empties bins (Staff.cpp:1037, :1085, :1147, :1227); path finding at :495

Mechanic: fixing state machine with enter-station, move-to-vehicle, fix restraints or doors, fix malfunction, station end and start, brakes, exit, finish fix or inspect (Staff.cpp:2003-2060); mid-job upgrade from inspect to fix at :2018-2019
Security guard: patrol area set by the player (Staff.cpp:265-293); alternate slow walk group when the patrol path is crowded (Staff.cpp:1718-1725)
Entertainer: nearby-visitor update (Staff.cpp:889, body not read); costume choice exists (STR_1946)
Visitor (guest): locale label STR_0767; guest code not read
zones: Climate zones (4): cool and wet, warm, hot and dry, cold (RCT12.h:45-51). Each has eight monthly patterns (Weather.h:39), a base temperature, a random bias and a 23-entry distribution of weather states (Weather.h:40). Pattern values are in the objects pack, not the box.

Weather states (9): sunny (+10), partly cloudy (+5), cloudy (0), rain (-2), heavy rain (-4), thunderstorm (+2), snow (-10), heavy snow (-15), blizzard (-20); temperature delta in brackets (Weather.cpp:48-58).
Hazards: thunder and lightning only under storm and blizzard effects; base thunder chance 0x1B4 (storm) and 0x6D (blizzard), shifted down by game speed (Weather.cpp:214-221).
Dungeon archetypes: none in the code read.

looks.label: Palette-index recolour
looks.technique: 8-bit index texture read and looked up in a 256-entry palette uniform in the fragment stage

looks.label: Gloom ladder
looks.technique: four named filter palettes (null, darken 1, darken 2, darken 3) keyed by gloom 0-3

looks.label: Lightning flash flag
looks.technique: random per-call roll sets a flash flag while a lightning timer runs; the renderer that clears it was not read

looks.label: Weather sound ramp
looks.technique: rain bed rises in steps of 80 to a capped volume and fades in steps until below a floor, then stops

looks.label: Glass map palettes (audit only)
looks.technique: translucent map palettes for a dimmed overlay; folders named, not re-read

looks.label: Bitmap font size ladder (audit only)
looks.technique: one glyph set in bold, small and tiny sizes; names only

originals.name: Storm Front
originals.idea: each zone runs a weather state that steps one unit at a time toward a forecast, with a storm that flashes and a thunder timer
originals.keep: stepwise transitions on a fixed tick boundary; forecast timer; storm-only lightning; lightning rate that drops with game speed
originals.change: forecast belongs to the zone, not the server clock; lightning is a one-frame rim flash plus one thunder cue

originals.name: Gloom Ladder
originals.idea: four discrete darkening steps keyed by a gloom value that each weather or zone sets
originals.keep: discrete steps and a mapping table
originals.change: steps tuned to a threat level and a cool grade

originals.name: Rain Bed Ramp
originals.idea: an ambient bed that rises in fixed steps to a cap and fades out in steps until a floor
originals.change: zone beds that crossfade at border tiles

originals.name: Responder Mid-Job Upgrade
originals.idea: a responder that begins by inspecting a downed object and switches to repairing when the fault shows
originals.keep: mid-job upgrade and the substate list
originals.change: revives a downed teammate in fight zones; no station and no brakes

originals.name: Crowd-Aware Warden
originals.idea: a patrol guard whose walk switches to a slow group when its path is crowded
originals.keep: crowd-aware walk switch; player-set patrol area
originals.change: slows near crowds, quickens on alarm, with a stance cue

originals.name: Helper Roles
originals.idea: four NPC helpers, each with one job loop
originals.keep: one role per helper with one signature job
originals.change: fight-zone roles: medic, fixer, warden, bard

originals.name: Palette-Index Zone Grade
originals.idea: one index texture per sprite set, looked up through a 256-entry palette per zone
originals.change: zone grade only; no team or ride colours

originals.name: Climate per Zone
originals.idea: each zone has a climate with a month-by-month distribution of weather states
originals.keep: data-driven climate with a pattern per season
originals.change: seasons are match phases; a threat season changes the mix
